cases.input: A Python analyzer reports unused redefinitions for class-local overload declarations imported from typing in an enclosing scope.
Adding another decorator to typing.overload declarations causes unused-redefinition diagnostics.
A decorated repeated function reports F811, but its decorator binding and diagnostic owner are unknown.
Two undecorated unused functions share a name and the analyzer reports their redefinition.
A runtime decorator dispatches incorrectly without a static unused-redefinition diagnostic.
